sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐形百分之九十九”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Mexico City, in case you've never been, is full of distinctive sounds.
sentences.zh: 如果你没去过墨西哥城，这座城市到处都是独特的声响。

sentences.en: There's the bell the garbage men ring, letting you know when it's time to come down and throw out your trash.
sentences.zh: 有垃圾工摇响的铃铛，提醒你该下楼扔垃圾了。

sentences.en: On some corners, you can hear organ grinders cranking out tunes for tips.
sentences.zh: 在某些街角，你能听到手摇风琴师演奏曲子来赚取小费。

sentences.en: There are, of course, the roving mariachi bands.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有四处游走的玛利亚奇乐队。

sentences.en: And there are the public markets, where you can hear countless vendors hawking their products.
sentences.zh: 还有公共市场，在那里你能听到无数小贩兜售商品的声音。

sentences.en: But there's one specific sound that cuts through the den, a voice that, if you've never heard it before, might stop you in your tracks.
sentences.zh: 但有一种特定的声音穿透了喧嚣，如果以前没听过，那个声音可能会让你当场驻足。

sentences.en: What you're hearing is a recording that trucks in Mexico City play on a relentless loop.
sentences.zh: 你听到的是墨西哥城货车上无休止循环播放的一段录音。

sentences.en: Reporter Ted Seifer.
sentences.zh: 记者特德·赛费尔。

sentences.en: The crews inside these trucks are looking to buy old household items and appliances.
sentences.zh: 这些货车上的工作人员正在寻找收购旧家居用品和电器的机会。

sentences.en: Basically, they're scrap metal haulers, and the recording is their pitch to prospective sellers.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们是废旧金属回收商，这段录音就是他们向潜在卖家推销的说辞。

sentences.en: We buy mattresses, bed frames, refrigerators.
sentences.zh: 我们回收床垫、床架、冰箱。

sentences.en: The list of appliances continues with stoves, washing machines, microwaves, and then crescendos gloriously with this line.
sentences.zh: 电器清单还包括炉灶、洗衣机、微波炉，然后以这句台词达到壮丽的高潮。

sentences.en: Which basically means, or any old metal thing you're selling.
sentences.zh: 这大致意思是，或者任何你要卖的旧金属物件。

sentences.en: This last bit has become the recording's namesake.
sentences.zh: 这最后一段成了这段录音的名字来源。

sentences.en: Fiero Viejo.
sentences.zh: 旧铁。

sentences.en: Literally, old iron.
sentences.zh: 字面意思就是旧铁。

sentences.en: The recording started popping up in neighborhoods surrounding the capital city in the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 这段录音在2000年代初开始出现在首都周边的社区。

sentences.en: But steadily, the sound caught the attention of the internet, and a growing number of amateur and not-so-amateur DJs and musicians.
sentences.zh: 但渐渐地，这个声音引起了互联网的注意，以及越来越多的业余和不太业余的DJ和音乐人的关注。

sentences.en: One of Mexico's major newspapers referred to Fiero Viejo as the most popular sound in all of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥的一家主流报纸将“旧铁”称为全墨西哥最受欢迎的声音。

sentences.en: Its status as a national icon may have been cemented at the World Cup last year when a Mexican fan blasted it out of a massive speaker he had strapped to his back.
sentences.zh: 它作为国家标志的地位可能在去年的世界杯上得到了巩固，当时一名墨西哥球迷用背上绑着的大型扬声器播放了这个声音。

sentences.en: So how and why did Fiero Viejo rise from the streets of Mexico City to become this huge sensation?
sentences.zh: 那么“旧铁”是如何以及为什么从墨西哥城的街头崛起，变成这样一个轰动一时的现象的呢？

sentences.en: The answer, it turns out, starts with a nine-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，答案要从一个九岁的小女孩说起。

sentences.en: A nine-year-old girl who helps solve a pressing challenge in a city that is busy, loud, and brimming with street vendors.
sentences.zh: 一个九岁的小女孩，她帮助解决了一个在繁忙、嘈杂且街头小贩云集的城市中面临的紧迫挑战。

sentences.en: Fiero Viejo is just one voice amid the cacophony of street selling in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥城街头小贩的杂音中，“旧铁”只是其中一个声音。

sentences.en: More than 50%, that's 5-0, of residents work in the informal economy.
sentences.zh: 超过50%，也就是5-0，的居民从事非正式经济活动。

sentences.en: In a metro area of 22 million, that's a lot of vendors who go out every day, selling tamales, pressing fresh juice, collecting old appliances for scrap.
sentences.zh: 在一个拥有2200万人口的大都市区，有大量的小贩每天外出，卖玉米粉蒸肉、榨鲜榨果汁、收集旧电器当作废品。

sentences.en: The main driver of this massive part of the economy is necessity.
sentences.zh: 这个庞大经济体的主要驱动力是需求。

sentences.en: There simply aren't enough jobs in Mexico's formal economy to go around.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥的正式经济中根本没有足够的工作岗位来满足所有人。

sentences.en: That makes street vending both a crowded space and a competitive one.
sentences.zh: 这使得街头小贩既是一个拥挤的行业，也是一个竞争激烈的行业。

sentences.en: You can hear the intensity of that competition playing out at the public markets, or tianguis, as the locals call them.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到这种竞争的激烈程度在公共市场，或当地人称之为“蒂安吉斯”的市场中上演。

sentences.en: There's a name for the calls vendors use to grab customers' attention in the middle of all this commotion.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些骚动中，小贩们用来吸引顾客注意力的叫卖声有一个专门的称呼。

sentences.en: They're called pregones, and there's an art to them, one that's been refined over the centuries.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为叫卖声，这是一门经过几个世纪打磨的艺术。

sentences.en: That's Liliana Jameica Silva.
sentences.zh: 那是莉莉安娜·哈梅卡·席尔瓦。
zh_words: 莉莉安娜·哈梅卡·席尔瓦

sentences.en: She's an anthropologist at the National School of Anthropology and History in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 她是墨西哥城国立人类学和历史学院的人类学家。

sentences.en: She says the term pregone has a long history in Mexico and can be traced back to the period of Spanish colonial rule.
sentences.zh: 她说，“叫卖”这个词在墨西哥有着悠久的历史，可以追溯到西班牙殖民统治时期。

sentences.en: In those days, pregones referred to the proclamations a designated town crier would make about new laws or notices of execution, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，“pregones”指的是指定的城镇传令官针对新法律或处决通知等事项所发布的公告。

sentences.en: This purpose has, of course, fallen by the wayside.
sentences.zh: 当然，这个用途现在已经荒废了。

sentences.en: But the tradition of pregones has been carried on by street vendors, who have long been important figures in Mexican culture.
sentences.zh: 但叫卖（pregones）的传统一直由街头小贩延续下来，他们在墨西哥文化中长期以来都是重要人物。

sentences.en: Y entonces, podemos ya encontrar en las películas, sobre todo en el cine mexicano, algunos de estos como pregones, no?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们现在已经可以在电影里，特别是墨西哥电影中，找到其中一些叫卖声，不是吗？

sentences.en: Por ejemplo, hay una película de...
sentences.zh: 比如，有一部电影...

sentences.en: Jameica told me that street vendors and their pregonists were often depicted during the golden age of Mexican cinema.
sentences.zh: 海梅卡告诉我，在墨西哥电影的黄金时代，街头小贩和他们的叫卖者经常被描绘在银幕上。

sentences.en: In a 1951 film, you can hear the famed Mexican comic known as Tintan singing the praises of his freshly baked bread while riding his bike through the city.
sentences.zh: 在1951年的一部电影中，你可以听到著名的墨西哥喜剧演员丁坦（Tintan）骑着自行车穿梭于城市时，歌颂他刚出炉的面包。

sentences.en: Panadero con el pan, tun tun, el panadero con el pan, el panadero con el pan, el panadero con el pan, el panadero con el pan.
sentences.zh: 卖面包的带着面包，咚咚，卖面包的带着面包，卖面包的带着面包，卖面包的带着面包，卖面包的带着面包。

sentences.en: Tempranito va y lo saca calientito en su canasta pa' salir con su clientela por las calles principales y también la ciudadela y después a los portales y el que no sale se queda sin el pan para comer.
sentences.zh: 一大早就去出炉热腾腾的面包放在篮子里，好去主要街道以及城堡区还有廊街寻找顾客，如果不出来的人就没面包可吃了。

sentences.en: Today, you can still hear some bread sellers using that little horn which people associate with the panadero.
sentences.zh: 今天，你依然可以听到一些面包小贩使用人们与面包师联系在一起的那种小喇叭。

sentences.en: The street vendors you hear in Mexico City do not generally burst into song, but there remains an element of performance in their pregones.
sentences.zh: 你在墨西哥城听到的街头小贩通常不会突然放声歌唱，但他们的叫卖声中仍然保留着一种表演的成分。

sentences.en: Vendors use distinctive intonations, cadences, and often clever turns of phrase to in effect create their own sonic niches.
sentences.zh: 小贩们运用独特的语调、韵律，以及常常很巧妙的措辞，来实际上创造出他们自己的声音细分市场。

sentences.en: This is especially important for itinerant vendors, the ones who sell their products in carts, trucks, or on foot.
sentences.zh: 这对于流动小贩来说尤其重要，也就是那些用手推车、卡车或步行售卖商品的人。

sentences.en: After all, they not only have to contend with the ambient noise of the city, but distracted customers who are busy doing other things.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他们不仅要应对城市的背景噪音，还要面对忙于做其他事情而分心的顾客。

sentences.en: This recording is played by vendors who ride around selling tamales oaxaqueños, tamales in the style of the Oaxaca region.
sentences.zh: 这段录音是由售卖瓦哈卡风味玉米粉蒸肉（tamales oaxaqueños）的小贩播放的。

sentences.en: Many mobile vendors, like the bread sellers, enhance their pregón with sounds like bells.
sentences.zh: 许多流动小贩，就像卖面包的一样，用铃铛之类的声音来增强他们的叫卖效果。

sentences.en: And sometimes the sound is so loud and so distinctive that no words are needed, like that of the sweet potato seller.
sentences.zh: 有时声音是如此响亮且独特，以至于根本不需要语言，比如卖红薯的小贩。

sentences.en: The cart he pushes, by the way, is an ingenious contraption.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，他推的手推车是一个巧妙的发明。

sentences.en: A little wood fire steams the potatoes and powers that piercing whistle.
sentences.zh: 一个小木火炉蒸熟红薯，并为那刺耳的哨声提供动力。

sentences.en: Then there's the roving cooking gas seller, who opts for simplicity with his pregón.
sentences.zh: 接下来是巡回售卖的液化气小贩，他的叫卖声选择保持简单。

sentences.en: Before Fierro Viejo the recording caught on, many scrap metal collectors shouted their pregones just like that gas seller.
sentences.zh: 在“旧铁器”（Fierro Viejo）录音流行之前，许多废金属回收商就像那个燃气小贩一样直接大声叫卖。

sentences.en: And some, though not many, still do.
sentences.zh: 虽然不多，但有些人现在仍然这样做。

sentences.en: Fierro Viejo, tambores, refrigeradores.
sentences.zh: 收旧铁、旧铜鼓、旧冰箱。

sentences.en: Antes era el pregónero que lo iba repitiendo.
sentences.zh: 以前是叫卖者亲自去重复喊着。

sentences.en: Ahora ya es un cassette o es un disco.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是磁带或光盘了。

sentences.en: O sea, se han ido transformando las maneras, pero el significado y el uso no.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，方式一直在转变，但意义和用途没有变。

sentences.en: Jameica explained that while things like cassettes and CDs have changed the means by which vendors deliver their pregones,
sentences.zh: 海梅卡解释说，虽然像磁带和光盘这样的东西改变了小贩传达叫卖声的手段，

sentences.en: their basic function has not changed.
sentences.zh: 但它们的基本功能并没有改变。

sentences.en: And Fierro Viejo may be the clearest and loudest expression of that trend.
sentences.zh: 而“旧铁器”可能是这种趋势最清晰、最响亮的表达。

sentences.en: While the Fierro Viejo recording fits squarely into Mexico's rich tradition of pregones,
sentences.zh: 虽然“旧铁器”的录音完全符合墨西哥丰富的叫卖传统，

sentences.en: it's also a stark departure from it.
sentences.zh: 但它也与这种传统有着鲜明的背离。

sentences.en: And that has everything to do with the voice that delivers it.
sentences.zh: 这与发出这个声音的嗓音有着密不可分的联系。

sentences.en: So high-pitched, it occupies its own sonic register.
sentences.zh: 音调如此之高，以至于占据了它自己的声音音域。

sentences.en: Each syllable delivered forcefully, yet almost wearily.
sentences.zh: 每个字都发音有力，却又带着几乎疲惫的语气。

sentences.en: The incongruity of it is arresting.
sentences.zh: 这种不协调感非常引人注目。

sentences.en: No sé qué cosa les causa el sonido de la niña, que todos los perros empiezan a huyar, ¿no?
sentences.zh: 我不知道这个小女孩的声音到底有什么魔力，所有的狗都开始嚎叫起来，对吧？

sentences.en: For her part, Jameica isn't sure what it is about the voice.
sentences.zh: 就她而言，海梅卡并不确定这个声音究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: But it does make all the dogs in her neighborhood howl.
sentences.zh: 但它确实让她邻居家的所有狗都嚎叫起来。

sentences.en: To get the story behind this iconic recording,
sentences.zh: 为了探寻这段标志性录音背后的故事，

sentences.en: I took a drive away from the swankier neighborhoods in central Mexico City
sentences.zh: 我开车离开墨西哥城中心那些高档街区，

sentences.en: to a place called Icatepec,
sentences.zh: 前往一个叫伊卡特佩克的地方，

sentences.en: a sprawling, dusty area of blocky buildings on the city's northern outskirts.
sentences.zh: 那是城市北部边缘一片广阔、尘土飞扬、由方块状建筑组成的地区。

sentences.en: That's where I met Marco Antonio Turon and his family.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，我遇到了马尔科·安东尼奥·图龙和他的家人。

sentences.en: Marco has had many jobs in his nearly 60 years.
sentences.zh: 马尔科在将近六十岁的人生中做过许多工作。

sentences.en: Cop, chef at a Japanese restaurant, bed frame seller.
sentences.zh: 警察、日本料理厨师、床架推销员。

sentences.en: But the family business, and his greatest love, is entertainment.
sentences.zh: 但家族生意，也是他最挚爱的事业，是演艺。

sentences.en: Ella es payasita, yo soy payasito, ella es chimbombita, yo soy chimbombin.
sentences.zh: 她是个小丑，我是个小丑，她是小不点，我是小不点他爸。

sentences.en: My daughter is a clown, I'm a clown.
sentences.zh: 我女儿是个小丑，我是一个小丑。

sentences.en: Her stage name is chimbombita, mine is chimbombin.
sentences.zh: 她的艺名叫奇姆邦比塔，我叫奇姆邦宾。

sentences.en: However, making a living as a clown is not easy.
sentences.zh: 然而，靠当小丑谋生并不容易。

sentences.en: Like everything, there's times when the clown business went down.
sentences.zh: 和所有事情一样，小丑生意也有走下坡路的时候。

sentences.en: The number of contracts went down.
sentences.zh: 演出合同减少了。

sentences.en: So talking with a cousin of mine, he says,
sentences.zh: 于是我和一个表亲聊天，他说，

sentences.en: well, why don't you work with your brother who's already working in scrap metal?
sentences.zh: 哎，你为什么不跟你那个已经做废品回收的兄弟一起干呢？

sentences.en: After a short time on his brother's scrap metal crew,
sentences.zh: 在他兄弟的废品回收队干了没多久后，

sentences.en: Marco decided to venture out on his own.
sentences.zh: 马尔科决定自己单干。

sentences.en: But he didn't have a truck, so he built a push cart.
sentences.zh: 但他没有卡车，于是他自己做了一辆手推车。

sentences.en: And that's what he would use to load and move heavy appliances.
sentences.zh: 这就是他用来装运重型家电的工具。

sentences.en: He would push the cart under the hot sun,
sentences.zh: 他要在烈日下推着车，

sentences.en: beckoning sellers by shouting through an improvised cardboard megaphone.
sentences.zh: 用一个自制的纸板喇叭大声吆喝来吸引卖家。

sentences.en: And you can imagine on foot, you arrive exhausted.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，靠双脚走路，到达时已经筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: And after so much screaming, my throat feels the same.
sentences.zh: 而且喊了那么多，我的嗓子也是一样。

sentences.en: With the sun, the heat, the duSt.
sentences.zh: 加上太阳、高温和灰尘。

sentences.en: I had a sore throat, bad feet, super tired.
sentences.zh: 我嗓子痛、脚疼，累得要命。

sentences.en: I will take the bus to my house,
sentences.zh: 我会坐公交车回家，

sentences.en: and there I will sit on the steps because my feet couldn't take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 然后坐在台阶上，因为我的脚实在受不了了。

sentences.en: One day, Marco had an idea.
sentences.zh: 有一天，马尔科有了一个主意。

sentences.en: He would make a recording of his pitch,
sentences.zh: 他要把自己的吆喝声录下来，

sentences.en: something other vendors sometimes did.
sentences.zh: 这有时是其他小贩也会做的事。

sentences.en: That way he wouldn't have to strain his vocal cords all day.
sentences.zh: 这样他就不用一整天都扯着嗓子喊了。

sentences.en: But Marco being Marco, he wanted to do the recording his own way.
sentences.zh: 但马尔科毕竟是马尔科，他想以自己的方式来录音。

sentences.en: And since he felt his own voice was too low and gravelly,
sentences.zh: 由于他觉得自己声音太低沉沙哑，

sentences.en: he turned to his nine-year-old daughter for help.
sentences.zh: 他找了他九岁的女儿来帮忙。

sentences.en: Yo soy la voz original del pregón.
sentences.zh: 我是这个吆喝声最初的原声。

sentences.en: Se compra colchones, tambores, refrigeradores, estufas, lavadoras,
sentences.zh: 收购床垫、架子鼓、冰箱、炉灶、洗衣机、

sentences.en: microondas, o algo de fierro viejo que vendan.
sentences.zh: 微波炉，或者任何你们要卖的旧铁烂铜。

sentences.en: So, I'm the original voice of the pregón.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是这个吆喝声最初的原声。

sentences.en: Se compran colchones, tambores, refrigeradores, estufas, lavadoras,
sentences.zh: 收购床垫、架子鼓、冰箱、炉灶、洗衣机、

sentences.en: microondas, o algo de fierro viejo que vendan.
sentences.zh: 微波炉，或者任何你们要卖的旧铁烂铜。

sentences.en: Meet Marimar Teron Martinez, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 认识一下玛丽马尔·特龙·马丁内斯，也就是
zh_words: 玛丽马尔·特龙·马丁内斯

sentences.en: the voice of Fiero Viejo.
sentences.zh: 废品之声的主人。

sentences.en: It wasn't exactly a stretch for Marimar, who is now 28 years old,
sentences.zh: 对于现在28岁的玛丽马尔来说，

sentences.en: to help out her father.
sentences.zh: 帮爸爸的忙算不上什么难事。

sentences.en: She had already elbowed her way into his clown act.
sentences.zh: 她早就凭实力挤进了他的小丑表演中。

sentences.en: Yo empecé a los ocho años.
sentences.zh: 我八岁就开始了。

sentences.en: Yo le dije, ¿sabes qué, papá?
sentences.zh: 我对他说，你知道吗，爸爸？

sentences.en: Yo quiero ser payasita.
sentences.zh: 我想当个小丑。

sentences.en: Y me dicen, pa, no, todavía no.
sentences.zh: 他们对我说，不行，现在还不行。

sentences.en: I was eight years old when I started.
sentences.zh: 我八岁时就开始了。

sentences.en: I said to him, you know what, Dad?
sentences.zh: 我对他说，你知道吗，爸爸？

sentences.en: I want to be a clown.
sentences.zh: 我想当个小丑。

sentences.en: And he was like, nope, not yet.
sentences.zh: 而他的反应就像是，不行，还不行。

sentences.en: And I was like, yes, please, I want to be.
sentences.zh: 我就说，求你了，我真的很想当。

sentences.en: And he would say, you're too small.
sentences.zh: 他会说，你太小了。

sentences.en: And I was like, no, please, Dad, until I convince him.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，不，求你了，爸爸，直到我劝服他。

sentences.en: And he said, okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，好吧，行吧。

sentences.en: But now let me be.
sentences.zh: 但现在让我静静。

sentences.en: Y me dijo, bueno, ya está bien, pero ya déjame en paz.
sentences.zh: 他对我说，好吧，行了，但现在放过我吧。

sentences.en: Entonces empezó.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始了。

sentences.en: No se iba conmigo.
sentences.zh: 她会跟我一起去。

sentences.en: Entonces la gente se muere de la risa.
sentences.zh: 人们都会笑得前仰后合。

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 对，

sentences.en: she would come with me and people die laughing because I fall down and she falls down and we're dancing and my pants are falling off and I'm trying to pick them up and we're still dancing and I drop her and she falls on me.
sentences.zh: 她会跟我一起去，人们笑得前仰后合，因为我摔倒了她也摔倒了，我们在跳舞，我的裤子掉下来了，我试图提上它，我们还在跳舞，我把她弄掉了，她摔在我身上。

sentences.en: People thought it was hilarious.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得这太搞笑惹人发笑了。

sentences.en: However, recording the Pregón was no time for funny business.
sentences.zh: 然而，录制吆喝声可不是开玩笑的时候。

sentences.en: Marco is a bit of a perfectioniSt.
sentences.zh: 马尔科有点完美主义。

sentences.en: Every word was rehearsed and since she forget what she had to say, I will put drawings of a mattress on it, a drawing of a washing machine.
sentences.zh: 每个词都排练过，既然她会忘词，我就会在上面画床垫的图画，画一台洗衣机的图画。

sentences.en: So for her, it was easier to read.
sentences.zh: 所以对她来说，读起来就更容易了。

sentences.en: Marco and Marimar did take after take after take after take, trying to get the sound right.
sentences.zh: 马尔科和玛丽马尔为了录出完美的声音，进行了一遍又一遍又一遍的尝试。

sentences.en: The recording began at 12 o'clock at night and we finished at about 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 录音从晚上12点开始，我们大约凌晨4点结束。

sentences.en: And that's because we wanted there to be no noise.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们希望周围没有任何噪音。

sentences.en: But, you know, there's always a dog that bark or some boyfriend who was looking for his girlfriend at 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，总会有狗在叫，或者某个男朋友在凌晨4点找他的女朋友。

sentences.en: So it took us several hours and I was very tired and you could hear it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们花了好几个小时，我非常累，你听得出来。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, I was like, se compran colchones and my dad would yell at me, Marimar, se compran colchones, tambores, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我就开始念起“se compran colchones”，然后我爸就会对我大喊：“玛丽玛尔，se compran colchones, tambores，巴拉巴拉巴拉。”

sentences.en: And he was like, no, no, no, you're already falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，不，不，不，你已经快睡着了。

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 我说，我很累。

sentences.en: And he was like, I know, but let's try to make sure that the recording goes well.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我知道，但我们得尽量确保录音顺利。

sentences.en: This may help explain the somewhat exasperated quality of the voice in Fiero Viejo.
sentences.zh: 这或许有助于解释《老菲耶罗》中那种略带恼怒的语气。

sentences.en: As much as Marimar wants your old refrigerator, she also just wants to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 尽管玛丽玛尔想要你旧的冰箱，但她现在只想去睡觉。

sentences.en: Eventually, the cassette was finished and Marco began playing it on his rounds.
sentences.zh: 最终，磁带制作完成了，马尔科开始在工作巡回中播放它。

sentences.en: Other scrap metal crews heard it and liked it.
sentences.zh: 其他废旧金属回收队听到了，觉得很不错。

sentences.en: So Marco sold it to them for a pittance, five pesos, the equivalent of about a quarter.
sentences.zh: 于是马尔科以微不足道的五比索把它卖给了他们，相当于大约二十五美分。

sentences.en: I believe that good faith always has rewards.
sentences.zh: 我相信善意总会有回报。

sentences.en: You do one thing for your partner, like give them the cassette for five pesos, which is what it costs.
sentences.zh: 你为合伙人做一件事，比如把磁带以五比索的原价卖给他们。

sentences.en: But you take it, no problem.
sentences.zh: 但你还是拿下了，没问题。

sentences.en: They are like crops you plant that will harvest later.
sentences.zh: 它们就像你种下的庄稼，日后自会有收成。

sentences.en: And so steadily, the sound began to spread across the city through the megaphones and loudspeakers of a growing number of beat-up pickup trucks.
sentences.zh: 就这样，这种声音开始通过越来越多的破旧小卡车上的扩音器和扬声器，在城市中传播开来。

sentences.en: Scrap metal collecting is just one small corner of Mexico's massive informal economy.
sentences.zh: 废金属回收只是墨西哥庞大非正规经济的一个小角落。

sentences.en: People have long carved out ways to make money whether or not the government approves of the activities.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，人们开辟了各种赚钱的方法，无论政府是否批准这些活动。

sentences.en: In fact, street vending is technically banned on the subway and in parts of the historic center.
sentences.zh: 事实上，地铁里和历史中心的部分地区在名义上是禁止街头兜售的。

sentences.en: Yet these settings are prime turf for vendors.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些地方却是小贩们的黄金地段。

sentences.en: So why do the authorities allow so many people to work on the streets?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么当局允许这么多人上街谋生呢？

sentences.en: The short answer is, they don't really have a choice.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们其实别无选择。

sentences.en: El Estado no tiene la capacidad de generar las condiciones para que haya crecimiento económico y empleos.
sentences.zh: 国家没有能力创造条件来实现经济增长和创造就业。

sentences.en: Pero tiene la responsabilidad de atender socialmente a esta gente.
sentences.zh: 但它有责任在社会上照顾这些人。

sentences.en: That's Carlos Alba Vega, a professor at the College of Mexico who has written books on the informal economy.
sentences.zh: 说话的是卡洛斯·阿尔巴·韦加，他是墨西哥学院的教授，曾撰写过关于非正规经济的书籍。

sentences.en: Carlos says the Mexican state does not have the capacity to create the conditions for economic growth and jobs,
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯表示，墨西哥国家没有能力创造经济增长和就业的条件，

sentences.en: but it does have the responsibility to serve those who work in the informal economy.
sentences.zh: 但它的确有责任服务那些在非正规经济中工作的人。

sentences.en: El Estado dice, entre comillas,
sentences.zh: 国家可以说是，打个比方，

sentences.en: Bueno, yo no tengo la posibilidad de ayudarte a resolver muchos problemas.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我没有能力帮你解决很多问题。

sentences.en: The state says, in effect, to street vendors,
sentences.zh: 实际上，国家对街头小贩说：

sentences.en: Well, I can't help you solve many probleMs.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我帮不了你解决很多问题。

sentences.en: You don't have social security.
sentences.zh: 你们没有社会保障。

sentences.en: If you get sick, you're on your own.
sentences.zh: 如果你生病了，只能靠你自己。

sentences.en: But what I can do is cover my eyes,
sentences.zh: 但我能做的是睁一只眼闭一只眼，

sentences.en: so that you do what you need to do and I tolerate.
sentences.zh: 好让你去做你需要做的事，而我予以容忍。

sentences.en: Entonces la tolerancia como una forma de redistribución social.
sentences.zh: 因此，容忍成了一种社会再分配的形式。

sentences.en: So tolerance as a form of social redistribution.
sentences.zh: 因此，容忍成了一种社会再分配的形式。

sentences.en: Because there are laws in the books against many aspects of informal commerce,
sentences.zh: 由于法律条文中存在反对非正规商业许多方面的条款，

sentences.en: enforcement often comes down to political expediency.
sentences.zh: 执法往往归结为政治上的权宜之计。

sentences.en: This leaves a huge gray area governed by unspoken codes and occasional bribes.
sentences.zh: 这留下了一个巨大的灰色地带，受潜规则和偶尔的贿赂所支配。

sentences.en: Alba told me that there is regulation of the informal economy,
sentences.zh: 阿尔巴告诉我，非正规经济是有监管的，

sentences.en: but it's an informal regulation.
sentences.zh: 但那是一种非正式的监管。

sentences.en: There are unwritten rules that vendors know and respect.
sentences.zh: 有一些小贩们知晓并遵守的不成文规则。

sentences.en: And if they don't respect them, there can be severe consequences, including violence.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不遵守，可能会产生严重的后果，包括暴力。

sentences.en: As parts of Mexico City become more gentrified,
sentences.zh: 随着墨西哥城的某些地区变得越来越中产阶级化，

sentences.en: there are signs that the tolerance Alba refers to may be wearing thin.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明，阿尔巴所说的宽容可能正在逐渐消失。

sentences.en: A recently enacted policy requires street food vendors in certain neighborhoods
sentences.zh: 一项最近颁布的政策要求某些街区的街头食品小贩

sentences.en: to display standardized signs with a city seal.
sentences.zh: 展示带有城市印章的标准化标志。

sentences.en: This did away with a long, rich tradition of colorful, hand-painted stalls.
sentences.zh: 这废除了色彩斑斓、手绘摊位的悠久而丰富的传统。

sentences.en: The city also recently passed rules concerning noise pollution.
sentences.zh: 该市最近还通过了关于噪声污染的规定。

sentences.en: While primarily aimed at construction sites and industrial businesses,
sentences.zh: 虽然主要针对建筑工地和工业企业，

sentences.en: it also applies to vehicles.
sentences.zh: 但它也适用于车辆。

sentences.en: And trucks blasting Fioro Viejo would very likely exceed the 68-decibel limit.
sentences.zh: 而播放《老废铁》的大卡车极有可能超过68分贝的限制。

sentences.en: None of the scrap metal crews I spoke with said they had received any tickets or fines,
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的废旧金属回收队中，没有人说他们收到过任何罚单或罚款，

sentences.en: but one guy did say that they were more likely to be hassled in certain areas.
sentences.zh: 但确实有一个家伙说他们在某些地区更容易受到骚扰。

sentences.en: He said they sometimes have problems in wealthier neighborhoods
sentences.zh: 他说他们有时在较富裕的街区会有麻烦，

sentences.en: because people are bothered by the noise.
sentences.zh: 因为人们对噪音感到厌烦。

sentences.en: And Fioro Viejo does have a way of injecting itself into one's daily life in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 而《老废铁》确实有一种闯入墨西哥城人们日常生活的方式。

sentences.en: This is something Mike Fortu was well aware of when he was studying music production about 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 大约10年前，麦克·福图在学习音乐制作时，对这一点就非常清楚。

sentences.en: He would often hear Fioro Viejo coming through the windows.
sentences.zh: 他经常听到菲奥罗·维耶霍的声音从窗外传进来。

sentences.en: It's so iconic, so loud.
sentences.zh: 它是如此标志性，声音又那么大。

sentences.en: You can't even complain.
sentences.zh: 你甚至无法抱怨。

sentences.en: Like, I live here in an apartment.
sentences.zh: 比如，我住在这里的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: I hear it three times a day.
sentences.zh: 我一天能听到三次。

sentences.en: And, like, you can't be mad at it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你真的生不起气来。

sentences.en: You know, it's part of the city.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是这座城市的一部分。

sentences.en: One day, Fortu was struck by something in the recording.
sentences.zh: 有一天，福图被录音中的某个东西吸引住了。

sentences.en: The rhythm.
sentences.zh: 节奏。

sentences.en: Ta-na-na, ta-na-na.
sentences.zh: 哒-纳-纳，哒-纳-纳。

sentences.en: It has a lot of musical elements in it.
sentences.zh: 它里面包含了很多音乐元素。

sentences.en: And just the timbre, the timbre of this little girl.
sentences.zh: 还有音色，这个小女孩的音色。

sentences.en: I put this 128 BPM electronic music intro and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我加了128BPM的电子音乐前奏之类的东西。

sentences.en: And it absolutely matched.
sentences.zh: 结果完全契合。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't edit it much.
sentences.zh: 真的，我没怎么编辑。

sentences.en: She just crashed the lines and the lyrics.
sentences.zh: 她完美地踩中了音轨和歌词。

sentences.en: Soon, Fioro Viejo, the dance remix, was born.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，菲奥罗·维耶霍的舞曲混音版诞生了。

sentences.en: Fortu may have been one of the first producers to sample Fioro Viejo, but he certainly was not the laSt.
sentences.zh: 福图可能是最早对菲奥罗·维耶霍进行采样的制作人之一，但他绝不是最后一个。

sentences.en: You can find tracks on Spotify and YouTube that riff on the Bragón in various ways.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Spotify和YouTube上找到以各种方式改编普拉贡叫卖声的曲子。

sentences.en: Probably the best produced song featuring Fioro Viejo dropped earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候发布的、由旧货回收喇叭声为特色的一首歌可能是制作最精良的。

sentences.en: It's a collaboration between three producers and rappers who go by El Huey Coyote, Fano, and Skiper.
sentences.zh: 这是由三位制作人兼说唱歌手合作完成的，他们分别叫埃尔·韦伊·科约特、法诺和斯基珀。

sentences.en: The video is excellent.
sentences.zh: 这部音乐视频太棒了。

sentences.en: The three rappers vamp it up like they're rolling in a tricked-out Lambo.
sentences.zh: 这三位说唱歌手表现得就像他们正开着一辆改装酷炫的兰博基尼兜风一样。

sentences.en: But they're actually in an utterly ragged old pickup, piled high with old mattresses and junk.
sentences.zh: 但他们实际上坐在一辆破破烂烂的老旧皮卡里，车上堆满了旧床垫和杂物。

sentences.en: El Huey Coyote told me it's sort of an homage.
sentences.zh: 埃尔·韦伊·科约特告诉我，这算是一种致敬。

sentences.en: It's a celebration of doing what you have to do to make a living, with a certain degree of style and ingenuity.
sentences.zh: 这是对为了谋生而不得不做该做的事的一种赞美，且带着某种程度的风格与机智。

sentences.en: In this sense, songs that sample Fioro Viejo are about more than winking irony.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，采样旧货回收喇叭声的歌曲不仅仅是为了带有暗示性的讽刺。

sentences.en: They're about an identity.
sentences.zh: 它们关乎一种身份认同。

sentences.en: Here's Mike Fortu again.
sentences.zh: 麦克·福图再次出场。

sentences.en: Yes, like if you play that, it's almost like an anthem, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你播放那个，它几乎就像是一首赞歌，你知道的。

sentences.en: You played it, as you said, in the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，你在世界杯上播放了它。

sentences.en: And people are gonna turn to find the wolf pack of the Mexicans, you know.
sentences.zh: 人们会转过头去寻找墨西哥人的狼群，你知道的。

sentences.en: We can be scattered around the world.
sentences.zh: 我们可以散落在世界各地。

sentences.en: And if you give us something to unite for and something to party, we're gonna rock the night there.
sentences.zh: 只要你给我们一个团结的理由和一个狂欢的理由，我们就能把那里的夜晚彻底点燃。

sentences.en: My interpreter, José Luis Viesca, a lifelong Mexico City resident, artist, and writer,
sentences.zh: 我的口译员何塞·路易斯·维耶斯卡是墨西哥城的一名终身居民、艺术家兼作家，

sentences.en: had an interesting perspective on why Fioro Viejo has resonated the way it has.
sentences.zh: 对旧货回收喇叭声为何能引起如此共鸣有着有趣的看法。

sentences.en: It speaks, I think, volumes.
sentences.zh: 我认为这说明了很多问题。

sentences.en: I think we're very proud of our creativity, you know, and how we always solve things with three clips and one piece of chewing gum.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们为自己的创造力感到非常自豪，你知道的，还有我们如何总是用三个回形针和一块口香糖就能解决问题。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I think it's something to be expected from Mexicans.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我认为这是墨西哥人理所应当的表现。

sentences.en: You will have somebody that takes a loudspeaker on their backpack in order to make noise.
sentences.zh: 你会看到有人把扩音器背在背包里用来制造噪音。

sentences.en: In order to attract attention, in order to precisely do something maybe surreal.
sentences.zh: 为了吸引注意力，为了精确地做出某种可能超现实的事情。

sentences.en: Surreal might be a good way to describe how it felt for Marimar when Fioro Viejo first started to spread across the city.
sentences.zh: 用“超现实”来形容当旧货回收喇叭声开始在全城传播时玛丽玛尔的感受，可能再合适不过了。

sentences.en: She was self-conscious about her voice, and even she found it a bit intrusive.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的声音感到不自在，甚至连她自己也觉得这声音有点打扰。

sentences.en: You're taking a shower, you're in a meeting, you're talking on the phone, you're arguing with your husband,
sentences.zh: 你正在洗澡，你在开会，你在打电话，你正在和丈夫争吵，

sentences.en: or you're having a romantic moment with your husband, and the recording plays.
sentences.zh: 或者你正在和丈夫享受浪漫时刻，而录音却响了起来。

sentences.en: So you hear the recording a lot all day long.
sentences.zh: 所以你一整天都会听到很多次这个录音。

sentences.en: A hell of a lot.
sentences.zh: 多得要命。

sentences.en: Despite her initial misgivings, Marimar has embraced the fame that comes with Fioro Viejo's popularity.
sentences.zh: 尽管最初有些疑虑，但玛丽玛尔还是接受了随着旧货回收喇叭声的流行而带来的名气。

sentences.en: She's performed Fioro Viejo live, and she's sat for interviews with prominent TV journalists.
sentences.zh: 她现场表演过旧货回收喇叭声，并接受了知名电视记者的采访。

sentences.en: She's even active on social media, under the names La Voz del Fioro Viejo and Niña del Llero.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在社交媒体上很活跃，化名“旧货回收喇叭之声”和“铁娘子”。

sentences.en: Literally, Girl of Iron.
sentences.zh: 字面意思就是，铁质女孩。

sentences.en: And social media has helped Marimar and Fioro Viejo gain an international fan base.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体帮助玛丽玛尔和旧货回收喇叭声赢得了国际粉丝群体。

sentences.en: Versions of the Pregón have been posted in other languages on TikTok and Instagram, like this one in French.
sentences.zh: 叫卖声的其他语言版本已经在TikTok和Instagram上发布了，比如这个法语版本。

sentences.en: Marimar has also used her fame to call attention to more serious matters,
sentences.zh: 玛丽玛尔还利用她的名气来唤起人们对更严重问题的关注，

sentences.en: like Mexico's high rates of violence against women and femicide.
sentences.zh: 比如墨西哥针对女性的高暴力率和杀害女性事件。

sentences.en: Last year, for International Women's Day, trucks rode through the streets of Mexico City,
sentences.zh: 去年国际妇女节时，墨西哥城的街头驶过一辆辆卡车，

sentences.en: blurring what sounded like Fioro Viejo, but with a very different set of messages.
sentences.zh: 播放着听起来像是《旧铁器》，但内容大不相同的录音。

sentences.en: International Women's Day was one of the few times Marimar agreed to lend the tune,
sentences.zh: 国际妇女节是玛丽玛尔为数不多同意将这个旋律，

sentences.en: and her magnificent pipes, to alternate versions of Fioro Viejo.
sentences.zh: 以及她那美妙的嗓音借给《旧铁器》改编版的时刻之一。

sentences.en: In this clip, the Pregón is played from speakers in the Zocalo,
sentences.zh: 在这个视频片段中，叫卖声正从索卡洛广场的扬声器里传出，

sentences.en: the massive historic plaza in the heart of Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 索卡洛广场是墨西哥城中心巨大的历史广场。

sentences.en: The words say in part,
sentences.zh: 歌词部分写道：

sentences.en: We invite you to the struggle that demands respect, equality, and justice for us and the new generations.
sentences.zh: 我们邀请您加入这场争取尊重、平等以及为我们和新一代争取正义的斗争。

sentences.en: Marco and Marimar hosted me earlier this year in the front yard of their home,
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，马尔科和玛丽玛尔在他们家的前院接待了我，

sentences.en: a small house with a cement floor that they share with Marimar's three kids.
sentences.zh: 那是一个铺着水泥地的小房子，他们和玛丽玛尔的三个孩子一起住在那里。

sentences.en: Despite the fame Fioro Viejo has brought them, the family still hustles to make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 尽管《旧铁器》给他们带来了名气，这一家人仍然在努力维持生计。

sentences.en: Marco, for his part, believes they haven't always gotten their due.
sentences.zh: 就马尔科而言，他认为他们并没有总是得到应有的回报。

sentences.en: He considers Fioro Viejo an artistic creation, and he says he's registered it and retained a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他认为《旧铁器》是一件艺术创作，并表示他已经注册了版权并请了律师。

sentences.en: The idea is that those who can pay should pay.
sentences.zh: 他的想法是，付得起钱的人应该付钱。

sentences.en: Songs, comedies, movies, short films, if they want to use it, they should pay because they can't afford it.
sentences.zh: 歌曲、喜剧、电影、短片，如果想用它，就应该付钱，因为他们付不起。

sentences.en: But for the carreteros, the people who buy scrap metal, it's very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但对收废品的车夫来说，这非常困难。

sentences.en: Very difficult.
sentences.zh: 非常困难。

sentences.en: Marco doesn't collect scrap metal as much as he used to, but he's still very much involved in the industry.
sentences.zh: 马尔科现在不像以前那样经常收废品了，但他依然深度参与这个行业。

sentences.en: Knowing how challenging the work can be, he started a union for collectors.
sentences.zh: 深知这项工作有多么不易，他为废品回收者成立了一个工会。

sentences.en: Members get help repairing their trucks, dealing with the authorities, and unlimited access to the recording of Fioro Viejo.
sentences.zh: 会员可以获得修理卡车、与当局打交道的帮助，以及无限次使用《旧铁器》录音的权限。

sentences.en: There is at least one constant in the lives of Marco and Marimar since the days he was pushing a cart and hollering out of a cardboard tube.
sentences.zh: 自从马尔科推着小车、用纸板卷筒大声叫卖的日子以来，马尔科和玛丽玛尔的生活中至少有一个是不变的。

sentences.en: They still perform as clowns.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然以小丑为业。

sentences.en: Only now, Fioro Viejo has become central to their act.
sentences.zh: 只是现在，《旧铁器》已经成为了他们表演的核心。

sentences.en: The truth is, it surprises me when we go to events and do that number, you have to tell me a sound from Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 事实是，每当我们去参加活动并表演那个节目时，这都让我感到惊讶，你得向我描述一个墨西哥城的声音。

sentences.en: And the children start, the one with the water, the one with the gas, de fierro viejo, and then they start, se compran colchones.
sentences.zh: 然后孩子们开始了，卖水的，卖瓦气的，收旧铁器的，接着他们开始喊，收旧床垫。

sentences.en: And it's something really cool.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件很酷的事情。

sentences.en: It's something that I love to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我很喜欢做的事。

sentences.en: Y es algo padrísimo, es algo que a mí me encanta hacer.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件太棒了、我特别喜欢做的事。

sentences.en: Making a living collecting household castoffs for scrap isn't easy.
sentences.zh: 靠收集废旧家电维持生计并不容易。

sentences.en: By crafting what is basically an extremely effective advertisement, the Turons eased the toil not only for themselves, but for legions of collectors in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 通过制作一个本质上极其有效的广告，图龙一家不仅减轻了他们自己的辛劳，也减轻了墨西哥广大废品回收者的辛劳。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just what those scrap metal trucks were collecting.
sentences.zh: 但这些收废品的卡车收集的不只是废品。

sentences.en: It's what they ended up offering.
sentences.zh: 它们最终提供的东西才是关键。

sentences.en: The unbridled, unbowed shout of a nine-year-old girl that for some reason echoed across Mexico and then the world.
sentences.zh: 一个九岁女孩无拘无束、不屈不挠的呐喊，不知为何在墨西哥乃至全世界回响。

sentences.en: More on the sounds of Mexico City after the break.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将继续为您带来更多关于墨西哥城声音的内容。

sentences.en: So, we are back with Ted Seifer, who has more to tell us about some of the street vending calls you heard earlier.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来，我们请到了特德·塞弗，他将为我们介绍更多你刚才听到的街头叫卖声。

sentences.en: Hey, Ted.
sentences.zh: 嗨，特德。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So, you may have noticed the recordings of some of those calls, specifically those in the public markets, were really well done.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能已经注意到，其中一些叫卖声的录音，特别是公共市场里的那些，制作得非常精良。

sentences.en: I did notice that.
sentences.zh: 我确实注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, many of them were just really clean and crisp.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们当中有很多声音真的非常干净、清脆。

sentences.en: They were fantastic.
sentences.zh: 它们太棒了。

sentences.en: Allí está el carrito de moda, carrito de temporada, mira, puro carrito de línea, se va de regalo, se va de remate.
sentences.zh: 看那辆时尚的时令手推车，纯正的直销货，大甩卖，清仓处理。

sentences.en: Barato, barato, te vale 35 pesos.
sentences.zh: 便宜，便宜，只要35比索。

sentences.en: Like, that one, you can even hear his intake of breath.
sentences.zh: 比如那个，你甚至能听到他吸气的声音。

sentences.en: It's that clean.
sentences.zh: 就是这么清晰。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So, I can't take credit for that recording.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不能把那段录音的功劳归功于自己。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Nor for some of the other ones that we heard of the market vendors.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的其他一些关于市场小贩的录音也不是。

sentences.en: They were made by a French sound engineer and sound artist named Felix Blum.
sentences.zh: 它们是一位名叫菲利克斯·布鲁姆的法国录音工程师和声音艺术家制作的。

sentences.en: He first came to Mexico City in 2009, and he was staying in the historic center of the city.
sentences.zh: 他于2009年首次来到墨西哥城，当时住在该市的历史中心。

sentences.en: So, it's super quiet during the night.
sentences.zh: 所以，那里在夜间超级安静。

sentences.en: It's really silent.
sentences.zh: 真的非常寂静。

sentences.en: Probably one of the most silent places of the city.
sentences.zh: 可能是这座城市最安静的地方之一。

sentences.en: But during the day, you have hundreds and hundreds of people, street sellers, screaming and announcing what they are selling and people going through.
sentences.zh: 但到了白天，这里会有成百上千的人、街头小贩，他们大声叫卖着自己卖的东西，人来人往。

sentences.en: And it was amazing for me to be there and to listen to all those sounds.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，能在那里并倾听所有这些声音，真是太奇妙了。

sentences.en: So, Felix, sound artist that he is, wanted to record the vendors.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为一名声音艺术家，菲利克斯想要录制小贩们的声音。

sentences.en: So, he got to know some of them and started recording their pregonas one-on-one, away from the noise of the public markets.
sentences.zh: 于是，他结识了其中一些人，并开始一对一地录制他们的叫卖声，远离公共市场的喧嚣。

sentences.en: And these recordings would become the basis for an exhibition that ran a few years ago called Quoro Informal, which means informal chorus.
sentences.zh: 这些录音成为了几年前举办的一个名为“Quoro Informal”（意为“非正式合唱”）展览的基础。

sentences.en: It was held at a place called the Fonoteca, a sound library and cultural center in Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 该展览在墨西哥城一个名为 Fonoteca 的声音图书馆和文化中心举行。

sentences.en: Basically, when visitors walked in, they'd see all these little wooden boxes.
sentences.zh: 基本上，当参观者走进去时，他们会看到所有这些小木箱。

sentences.en: And when people opened them, out came a pregon.
sentences.zh: 当人们打开它们时，就会传出一声叫卖声。

sentences.en: And then they could also see its musical score along with an illustration of the vendor.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还可以看到它的乐谱以及小贩的插图。

sentences.en: Wow, that is so amazing.
sentences.zh: 哇，太神奇了。

sentences.en: What a great exhibit.
sentences.zh: 多么棒的展览啊。

sentences.en: And also, just like, selfishly, it was so useful for our story to have all these clean, beautiful recordings that he made.
sentences.zh: 而且，从某种私心来讲，他制作的所有这些清晰、美妙的录音对我们的故事太有用了。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: But Felix was not content just to be a documentarian.
sentences.zh: 但菲利克斯并不满足于只做一个纪录片制作人。

sentences.en: He decided that he would try his hand at street vending as well.
sentences.zh: 他决定自己也尝试一下街头叫卖。

sentences.en: So, he makes a CD called Disco Pirata, which means pirate CD.
sentences.zh: 于是，他制作了一张名为“Disco Pirata”的CD，意思是“盗版CD”。

sentences.en: Viva Mexico!
sentences.zh: 墨西哥万岁！

sentences.en: Viva!
sentences.zh: 万岁！

sentences.en: Cienso Minidos.
sentences.zh: 一百分钟。

sentences.en: Cella te disco, padre.
sentences.zh: 这张光盘很棒，朋友。

sentences.en: Más de tres horas de duración.
sentences.zh: 时长超过三小时。

sentences.en: That's Felix in the intro to the CD, saying it's three hours long with over a hundred sounds of the city.
sentences.zh: 那是CD开场白中的菲利克斯，说它有三个小时长，包含了一百多种城市的声音。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's pretty ambitious.
sentences.zh: 这相当有雄心。

sentences.en: Basically, Felix styled the disc after the pirate CDs that you can find being hawked in public markets and subway cars.
sentences.zh: 基本上，菲利克斯将这张光盘设计成你在公共市场和地铁车厢里兜售的盗版CD的风格。

sentences.en: They made offer, say, the top 100 cumbia or reggaeton hits of the current day.
sentences.zh: 它们可能会提供，比方说，当今最热门的100首坎比亚或雷鬼精选。

sentences.en: As you can imagine, Felix's disc did not just feature jams like Fioro Viejo, but deep cuts, like the balloon vendor and the knife sharpener.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，菲利克斯的光盘不仅有《Fioro Viejo》这样的热门歌曲，还有气球小贩和磨刀人等冷门曲目。

sentences.en: Felix then boarded subway cars and tried to sell the CD in the style of the locals.
sentences.zh: 随后，菲利克斯登上地铁车厢，试图以当地人的风格出售这张CD。

sentences.en: He certainly was committed to the bit.
sentences.zh: 他确实对这个段子很投入。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty gutsy to, you know, sell your Pregone's CD with a French accent, you know, like on a crowded subway car.
sentences.zh: 我是说，带着法国口音去兜售你的叫卖声CD，你知道的，比如在拥挤的地铁车厢里，这挺有胆量的。

sentences.en: Like, did he end up selling a bunch of these?
sentences.zh: 话说，他最后卖出去了一大堆吗？

sentences.en: Well, from a commercial perspective, it wasn't so successful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从商业角度来看，它并不是那么成功。

sentences.en: He said he only sold a few discs.
sentences.zh: 他说他只卖出了几张光盘。

sentences.en: So it wasn't so easy to scream.
sentences.zh: 所以大声叫喊并不是那么容易。

sentences.en: And then I met some people selling discs at this time and they said, well, you should do it like this.
sentences.zh: 然后我当时遇到了一些卖光盘的人，他们说，嗯，你应该这样做。

sentences.en: You should go on this line, the green line.
sentences.zh: 你应该走这条线，绿线。

sentences.en: The green line is better for you because it's like university and they will like this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 绿色的那条对你更好，因为它就像大学一样，他们会喜欢这种东西。

sentences.en: And they even tried to sell it for me.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还试着帮我把它卖出去。

sentences.en: I gave, well, I can give you a few copies and try to sell it.
sentences.zh: 我给了，嗯，我可以给你几份去试着卖卖看。

sentences.en: So the other vendors were giving him pointers for how to shout and sell some things at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以其他摊贩在教他怎么一边吆喝一边卖东西。

sentences.en: That's really amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真的很奇妙。

sentences.en: It sounds like Felix was really inspired by the sounds of Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 听起来费利克斯确实从墨西哥城的声音中获得了许多灵感。

sentences.en: I mean, did you get a sense from him like what he was really going for in his art when he was archiving these and presenting them?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你从他那里了解到他归档并展示这些声音时，他的艺术追求到底是什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we chatted about that.
sentences.zh: 对，我们聊过这个。

sentences.en: One of his goals was definitely documentary, right?
sentences.zh: 他的目标之一绝对是记录，对吧？

sentences.en: He wanted to record the vendor calls because they are such an easily overlooked and ephemeral part of the city's identity.
sentences.zh: 他想要录下小贩的吆喝声，因为这是这座城市身份中极其容易被忽视且短暂的一部分。

sentences.en: I think the act of recording in general, it's like building a memory of a place.
sentences.zh: 我觉得录音这种行为本身，就像是在为某个地方建立记忆。

sentences.en: It's building memory from a moment or from people leaving these territories.
sentences.zh: 它是由某一刻或由人们离开这些地方的记忆构建而成的。

sentences.en: Or probably those sounds will disappear at some point.
sentences.zh: 或者这些声音可能在某个时候就会消失。

sentences.en: They will change at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少它们会发生变化。

sentences.en: So I personally experienced what Felix is talking about here, how the sounds of the city change and evolve over time.
sentences.zh: 所以我亲身体验到了费利克斯在这里所说的话，即这座城市的声音是如何随时间变化和演变的。

sentences.en: For example, this is Felix's recording of a tamale vendor.
sentences.zh: 比如，这是费利克斯录下的一个塔马雷斯玉米粉蒸肉小贩的声音。

sentences.en: And here's the pergón by the same guy, mind you, that I heard when I was in the city.
sentences.zh: 这是同一个人唱的叫卖歌，顺便说一句，这也是我在城里时听到的。

sentences.en: I mean, I personally like the current one.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我个人更喜欢现在这个版本。

sentences.en: The lyrics, so to speak, are more complex.
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢，它的歌词更复杂一些。

sentences.en: It's got a nice flow.
sentences.zh: 它的韵律感很好。

sentences.en: These are the kind of things that you start to notice when you spend a lot of time, maybe too much time, listening to pergónis.
sentences.zh: 当你花大量时间——也许是太多时间——去听叫卖歌时，你就会开始注意到这些事情。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Anyway, it was important for Felix to try and capture and preserve these sounds.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，对费利克斯来说，试着捕捉和保存这些声音是很重要的。

sentences.en: But he had another goal with his sound projects, and that has to do with the notion of public space.
sentences.zh: 但他的声音项目还有另一个目标，这与公共空间的概念有关。

sentences.en: The public space is a space for all.
sentences.zh: 公共空间是属于所有人的空间。

sentences.en: It's a place to be able to be listened to.
sentences.zh: 这是一个能够被倾听的地方。

sentences.en: And this all happens in the public space.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都发生在公共空间里。

sentences.en: And I think that's the important things of listening to this public space, to listen to what people want to say, to what people is saying.
sentences.zh: 我认为倾听这个公共空间的重要之处在于，去听听人们想说什么，听听人们在说什么。

sentences.en: And maybe not enough people are listening to them.
sentences.zh: 也许倾听他们的人还不够多。

sentences.en: That's so true, and I'm so glad that more people are listening.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，我很高兴有更多的人在倾听。

sentences.en: And I'm so happy with this story, and I got to hear these pergónis for myself.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴能听到这个故事，而且我自己也听到了这些叫卖歌。

sentences.en: So I really appreciate it, Ted.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很感激，泰德。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: It was my pleasure, Roman.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸，罗曼。

sentences.en: It was a really fun story to work on.
sentences.zh: 制作这个故事真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: We are part of the Stitcher and SiriusXM podcast family, now headquartered six blocks north in the Pandora building, in beautiful, uptown, Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是 Stitcher 和 SiriusXM 播客家族的一部分，总部现在位于加利福尼亚州美丽的奥克兰市中心上城区潘多拉大厦向北六个街区。

sentences.en: You can find the show and join discussions about the show on Facebook.

sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上 @ 我 @Roman Mars 以及节目 @99pi.org。

sentences.zh: 我们也在 Instagram、Reddit 和 TikTok 上。
